svg.title: Clearview House cable management portfolio concept
svg.desc: Fictional it support portfolio concept for Clearview House, showing professional under-desk cable management with safe connections. Purpose-built demonstration visual for LocalPro Directory; it does not depict a real business, credential, review or completed client project.
